headline: ESPN streaming plans are getting more expensive
summary: ESPN is hiking its subscription prices starting September 17th. The ad-supported Select plan rises to $13.99, while the Unlimited plan increases to $31.99. These price adjustments will also impact existing Disney Plus bundles.

headline: Raspberry Pi shares its official tutorial for making a cyberdeck
summary: Raspberry Pi has released an official tutorial for building a cyberdeck. The head of social noted the growing popularity of these custom portable computers. Cyberdecks are often crafted from repurposed items like purses or jewelry boxes.

headline: Apple’s four-pack of second-gen AirTags is $20 off
summary: Apple's four-pack of second-generation AirTags is now $79, marking a $20 discount. This bundle deal is available at both Amazon and Target. It represents the lowest price yet for the AirTag multi-pack.

headline: How GoFundMe became America’s backup plan
summary: The Decoder podcast features an interview with Tim Cadogan, CEO of GoFundMe. GoFundMe serves as a major platform for diverse fundraising needs across America. It supports causes from medical expenses to youth sports and new businesses.

headline: Control Resonant Made Me Feel Foolish For Ever Doubting It
summary: An IGN First preview expresses strong newfound confidence in Control Resonant. The reviewer's doubts were dispelled after playing two brand new missions. This final preview highlights the game's surprising quality and potential.

headline: Dave Franco and the Cast of Idiots Break Down the Comedy's Most Explosive Scene
summary: Dave Franco and the cast discuss their upcoming comedy, 'Idiots.' They delve into the film's title change, unexpected twists, and explosive moments. Director Macon Blair also provides insights into the movie's production.

headline: The Folio Society Reveals The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past
summary: The Folio Society has unveiled a luxurious hardcover edition of 'The Three-Body Problem Trilogy.' Titled 'Remembrance of Earth's Past,' it's a premium collectible for fans. This edition caters to those willing to invest in Liu Cixin's epic sci-fi series.

headline: Samsung's Absolutely Massive 57" Dual 4K Gaming Monitor Drops to the Lowest Price I've Ever Seen
summary: Samsung's huge 57-inch dual 4K gaming monitor has hit its lowest recorded price. This massive display offers an incredibly immersive experience for gamers. The significant price drop makes it an attractive deal for high-end setups.

headline: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
summary: Burnham has pledged continued support for Ukraine, disregarding Russian threats. Moscow warned of 'consequences' after reports of UK drones used by Ukraine. The UK stance remains firm amid escalating international tensions.

headline: Is UK's Storm Shadow missile a game changer for Ukraine?
summary: Correspondent Joe Inwood analyzes the potential impact of the UK's Storm Shadow missile. This weapon technology could significantly alter the course of the Russia-Ukraine war. Experts are assessing whether it truly represents a 'game changer' for Ukrainian forces.

headline: Snooker champion Graeme Dott guilty of child sex abuse
summary: Former world snooker champion Graeme Dott has been found guilty of child sex abuse. He was convicted of lewd and libidinous behavior. The charges involved both a young girl and a boy.

headline: Race Across the World star Jo Gardiner dies aged 61 one year after son's death
summary: Jo Gardiner, a former contestant on 'Race Across the World,' has died at age 61. She passed away from cancer, a year after her son's death. Her son had tragically died in a crash the previous year.
